children: Materialise NV posted Q3 2026 revenue of €67.7M (+2% YoY), Adjusted EBIT €2.5M (3.7% margin), and reaffirmed FY26 revenue of €273M–€283M and Adjusted EBIT of €12M–€14M.

AI Analyst View
Q3 revenue €67.7M, up 2% YoY
Low growth but positive; shows resilience post divestitures.
Q3 Adj. EBIT €2.5M, margin 3.7%
Profitability slipped vs 4.4% prior; margin pressure matters.
Medical revenue €36.5M, up 9.7% YoY
Core growth engine; offsets softness elsewhere.
Software revenue €9.9M, down YoY
Decline in higher-margin segment weighs on profits.
Manufacturing €21.3M; adj. EBITDA -€0.3M
Improving losses; adjusted rev +1.5% excl. divests.
FY26 rev €273–€283M; Adj. EBIT €12–€14M
Reaffirmed outlook reduces downside risk near term.
Context by AI Analyst

This is a mid-cycle update showing stable growth with mix shifts: Medical strong, Software softer, Manufacturing improving post divestitures. A stronger margin inflection or upside to guidance on the call would turn this into a larger catalyst.
